name: airflow
install: UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT={venv} uv sync -q --python 3.12 --frozen --all-packages || UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT={venv} uv sync -q --python 3.12 --all-packages
build: rm -rf {work}/afhome {work}/afh && mkdir -p {work}/afhome {work}/afh && AIRFLOW_HOME={work}/afhome AIRFLOW__DATABASE__SQL_ALCHEMY_CONN=sqlite:///{work}/afhome/unittests.db {py} -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --with-db-init airflow-core/tests/unit/utils/test_helpers.py -x > {work}/afbuild.log 2>&1; tail -5 {work}/afbuild.log; test -f {work}/afhome/.airflow_db_initialised
cmd: h={work}/afh/$(printf %s '{unit}' | md5sum | cut -c1-12); rm -rf $h; cp -r {work}/afhome $h; AIRFLOW_HOME=$h AIRFLOW__DATABASE__SQL_ALCHEMY_CONN=sqlite:///$h/unittests.db exec {py} -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -p s2_report {unit}

ci.source: assumed 4 vCPU per test job (Airflow CI splits test types over many jobs)
